fixtures.preview: United host Bournemouth on Sunday, three days after a 4-1 Champions League defeat at Como, with Michael Carrick's side winless in seven.
talking_points: United are winless in seven in all competitions and have not kept a clean sheet this season, per Sky Sports.
Bruno Fernandes has publicly criticised the tactical plan, adding to the pressure on Carrick.
Marcus Rashford (hip), Lisandro Martínez and Ayden Heaven are possible returns; Benjamin Sesko (shin) is doubtful with no return date.
Kobbie Mainoo is expected back around the Chelsea game and Luke Shaw around the Roma game; Sky lists Leny Yoro as suspended.

fixtures.preview: A 12:30pm UK trip to Stamford Bridge on Saturday 31 October; Mainoo is expected to be back around then.
Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase brings Roma to Old Trafford, where Shaw could return.
A Sunday 4:30pm UK home game against Aston Villa, picked for TV.
The trip to Anfield is set for Sunday 22 November at 4:30pm UK time, live on Sky Sports in the UK.
A Sunday 3pm home game, part of a double-header with Sydney FC Women v Melbourne City at 5:45pm.
talking_points: Sydney opened with a 0-0 derby draw against Western Sydney, with no shot on target until the 91st minute.
Sydney have kept 13 clean sheets since the start of last season, the most in the league.
They are winless in seven at Allianz Stadium (five draws, two losses) and have drawn their last three there.
I couldn't find Adelaide's form or team news for Sunday.

fixtures.preview: A 5pm Halloween game at AAMI Park, Melbourne City's home opener.
A Friday-night home game against the Mariners (round 4).
An away trip to Brisbane Roar at Kayo Stadium, 6:40pm Brisbane time (7:40pm Sydney).
The Big Blue at Allianz Stadium on Sunday 6 December at 5pm, per the club's ticket page.

big_matches.title: Barcelona v Real Madrid (El Clásico)
big_matches.why: First Clásico of the season at Camp Nou, with Barcelona top of LaLiga and Real Madrid third (Mon 26 Oct, 7am Sydney).
talking_points: Barcelona lead LaLiga and have scored 39 goals in nine matches; Madrid, third, have 23.
Barcelona have won six of the last seven Clásicos in all competitions.
Vinícius Júnior is banned and Barcelona's Olmo is out; Raphinha's status is unclear.
Mbappé has one win from six against Barcelona.

Arsenal drew 2-2 at Bayern on Wednesday.

notes: Many sites blocked access (HTTP 403) or returned stale results, so several sections are shorter than their limits rather than padded.

Man Utd: team news is from Sky Sports (22 Oct) and Brit Brief (23 Oct), and the sources differ on some players (e.g. Yoro suspended, Sesko doubtful). I couldn't open manutd.com, so later fixtures weren't re-checked against the club site. Australian broadcasters for Premier League and Champions League games weren't confirmed, so broadcast is blank.
Sydney FC: fixtures after 25 Oct were carried over and not re-checked; Paramount+ is assumed as the A-Leagues broadcaster. No Adelaide team news was found.
Big matches: only El Clásico has a confirmed Australian broadcaster (beIN Sports). Check Stan Sport or Paramount+ for the others. Wallabies November Tests had no confirmed times.
Live sport: Kings start times aren't published on the venue page. No rugby union or tennis in Sydney in the next 4 weeks was found.
Local: school events come from the downloaded Term 4 calendars and Week 2 updates. Nothing was found for the other school, and no South Eveleigh events page could be opened.
Not found: matcha pop-ups in Sydney, junior parkrun or kids' fun runs near home, Pokémon/Minecraft/Roblox events, and confirmed sports-gear sales.
Groceries: Woolworths and Coles half-price lists weren't accessible, so most items have no was-price. Aldi tuna runs to 30 Nov; the other Aldi items end 27 Oct.
Horizon: entries other than the Rugby World Cup were carried over without re-checking.
